instruction: Create exactly one valid closed solid triangular prism. In local coordinates its base triangle is (0,0,0), (80,0,0), (0,40,0), closed back to the start, and it extends 25 mm along local +Z. Rotate this geometry +30 degrees about the WORLD Z axis through world (0,0,0), then translate it by world vector (120,-40,15) mm. These operations specify the final pose, not a mandatory tool sequence. Preserve the triangle's handedness. Remove the construction profile and leave no other objects. All units are millimeters. Verify your work using available tools.
